settings.name: AUTO_LETS_ENCRYPT
settings.description: **Enable Let's Encrypt:** Set to `yes` to enable automatic certificate issuance and renewal.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_PASSTHROUGH
settings.description: **Pass Through Let's Encrypt:** Set to `yes` to pass through Let's Encrypt requests to the web server. This is useful when BunkerWeb is in front of another reverse proxy handling SSL.

settings.name: EMAIL_LETS_ENCRYPT
settings.description: **Contact Email:** Email address used for Let's Encrypt expiry reminders. Leave blank only if you accept that no alerts or recovery emails will be sent (Certbot registers with `--register-unsafely-without-email`).

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_SERVER
settings.description: **Certificate Authority:** Select the ACME server to use for issuance. Options: `letsencrypt` or `zerossl`.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_ZEROSSL_API_KEY
settings.description: **ZeroSSL API Key:** Optional API key used by `zerossl-bot` when `LETS_ENCRYPT_SERVER=zerossl`. If empty, `EMAIL_LETS_ENCRYPT` is used to retrieve EAB credentials.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_ZEROSSL_API_RETRY
settings.description: **ZeroSSL API Retries:** Number of retries for ZeroSSL API requests made by `zerossl-bot` (`0` disables retries).

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_ZEROSSL_API_RETRY_DELAY
settings.description: **ZeroSSL Retry Delay:** Delay in seconds between ZeroSSL API retries in `zerossl-bot`. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_ZEROSSL_API_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **ZeroSSL Connect Timeout:** Connection timeout in seconds for ZeroSSL API calls in `zerossl-bot`. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_ZEROSSL_API_MAX_TIME
settings.description: **ZeroSSL Request Max Time:** Maximum total time in seconds for each ZeroSSL API call in `zerossl-bot`. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_CHALLENGE
settings.description: **Challenge Type:** Method used to verify domain ownership. Options: `http` or `dns`.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_DNS_PROVIDER
settings.description: **DNS Provider:** When using DNS challenges, the DNS provider to use (e.g., cloudflare, route53, digitalocean).

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_DNS_PROPAGATION
settings.description: **DNS Propagation:** The time to wait for DNS propagation in seconds. If no value is provided, the provider's default propagation time is used. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_DNS_CREDENTIAL_ITEM
settings.description: **Credential Item:** Configuration items for DNS provider authentication (e.g., `cloudflare_api_token 123456`). Write the key, whitespace, then the value, and do not quote the key. Values can be raw text, base64 encoded, or a JSON object.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_DNS_CREDENTIAL_DECODE_BASE64
settings.description: **Decode Base64 DNS credentials:** Automatically decode base64-encoded DNS provider credentials when set to `yes`. Values matching base64 format are decoded before use (except for the `rfc2136` provider). Set to `no` if your credentials are intentionally base64 strings.

settings.name: USE_LETS_ENCRYPT_WILDCARD
settings.description: **Wildcard Certificates:** When set to `yes`, creates wildcard certificates for all domains. Only available with DNS challenges.

settings.name: USE_LETS_ENCRYPT_STAGING
settings.description: **Use Staging:** When set to `yes`, uses Let's Encrypt's staging environment for testing. Staging has higher rate limits but produces certificates that are not trusted by browsers.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_CLEAR_OLD_CERTS
settings.description: **Clear Old Certificates:** When set to `yes`, removes old certificates that are no longer needed during renewal.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
settings.description: **Concurrent Requests:** When set to `yes`, certbot-new issues certificate requests concurrently. Use with caution to avoid rate limits.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_PROFILE
settings.description: **Certificate Profile:** Select the certificate profile to use. Options: `classic` (general-purpose, up to 100 names), `tlsserver` (optimized for TLS servers, 45-day validity, up to 25 names), or `shortlived` (160-hour certificates, up to 25 names).

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_CUSTOM_PROFILE
settings.description: **Custom Certificate Profile:** Enter a custom certificate profile if your ACME server supports non-standard profiles. This overrides `LETS_ENCRYPT_PROFILE` if set.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_DISABLE_PUBLIC_SUFFIXES
settings.description: **Disable Public Suffix Check:** When set to `yes`, domains are not checked against the Public Suffix List before a certificate is requested. Set to `no` to refuse requests for domains that match a public suffix (for example `co.uk`).

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_MAX_RETRIES
settings.description: **Maximum Retries:** Number of times to retry certificate generation on failure. Set to `0` to disable retries. Useful for handling temporary network issues or API rate limits.

settings.name: LETS_ENCRYPT_MAX_LOG_BACKUPS
settings.description: **Maximum Certbot Log Backups:** Number of rotated `letsencrypt.log` backups certbot keeps per job. Certbot's own default of 1000 piles up quickly; `50` is a sensible cap. Set to `0` to keep only the live log.
